tasks.subject: Task 1: gravity.py — the eased quarter-turn
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One pure module owning gravity direction as a single eased scalar, with an integer target that cannot drift.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/gravi/gravity.py`
- Test: `tests/test_gravity.py`
- Modify: `tests/test_purity.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] GravityState.angle eases over flip_duration and lands exactly on the target
- [ ] After 500 alternating flips the settled angle is exactly target_turns * pi/2 — no drift
- [ ] flip_to on a 180 degree turn takes the clockwise path (phi decreases)
- [ ] settle(turns) jumps to an orientation with no ease, for spawning
- [ ] gravity.py imports nothing but math and dataclasses

**Verify:** `PYTHONPATH= .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_gravity.py tests/test_purity.py -v` -> all pass

**Steps:** see the task section in the plan document for the full TDD steps and code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/gravi/gravity.py", "tests/test_gravity.py", "tests/test_purity.py"], "verifyCommand": "PYTHONPATH= .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_gravity.py tests/test_purity.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ease lands exactly on target", "no drift over 500 flips", "180 degrees goes clockwise", "settle() jumps with no ease", "no pygame import"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: chamber.py — geometry, generation, streamed chain
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A chamber is a box in its own frame; chambers chain by placing the next entrance at the previous exit; the chain generates ahead and retains outlines behind.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/gravi/chamber.py`
- Test: `tests/test_chamber.py`
- Modify: `tests/test_purity.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Chamber.local(x, y) returns (depth, lateral offset) in the chamber frame
- [ ] Over 300 seeds no generated core lies within core_radius + player_radius + margin of the centre lane (spec 4.3)
- [ ] In every chamber at least one influence ring reaches across the centre lane
- [ ] Chambers chain with no gap: entry == previous exit_center, direction == previous next_direction
- [ ] The same seed always produces an identical chain
- [ ] ensure_ahead keeps >= 3 chambers past the current one; cleared outlines are retained for the path map
- [ ] chamber.py imports only math, random, dataclasses and .field

**Verify:** `PYTHONPATH= .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_chamber.py tests/test_purity.py -v` -> all pass

**Steps:** see the task section in the plan document for the full TDD steps and code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/gravi/chamber.py", "tests/test_chamber.py"], "verifyCommand": "PYTHONPATH= .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_chamber.py tests/test_purity.py -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["centre lane clear over 300 seeds", "rings reach the lane", "chambers chain without gaps", "deterministic by seed", "outlines retained on advance"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: sim.py — run the world on a chamber chain
tasks.description:
**Goal:** World steps a point mass through a streamed chamber chain: rotating gravity, gravity-relative clamps, arrow crossing, chamber advance, death by core or sideways exit.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/gravi/sim.py`
- Modify: `tests/test_sim.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] At phi = 0 the clamp is behaviourally identical to slice 1's vx/vy split
- [ ] Carry is untouched by gravity at phi in {0, 90, 180, 270} degrees
- [ ] Crossing the exit plane inside the span advances the chamber and flips gravity by -turn quarter turns
- [ ] Crossing outside the span, drifting past the side wall, or being thrown back out of the entrance all kill
- [ ] Entry lateral offset into the next chamber is always exactly zero
- [ ] Core contact anywhere in the three live chambers kills
- [ ] Attract rope holds past the rim, repel rope breaks at the rim (slice 1 2.2.1 behaviour preserved)
- [ ] sim.py still imports no pygame

**Verify:** `PYTHONPATH= .venv/bin/pytest tests/ -v` -> all pass (the whole suite)

**Steps:** see the task section in the plan document for the full TDD steps and code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/gravi/sim.py", "tests/test_sim.py"], "verifyCommand": "PYTHONPATH= .venv/bin/pytest tests/ -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["clamp reduces to slice 1 at phi 0", "carry untaxed at every orientation", "crossing advances and flips by -turn", "entry offset always zero", "sideways exit kills"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: render/camera.py — rotation at draw time
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One transform mapping world to screen, holding rotation and follow, so world coordinates never rotate.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/gravi/render/camera.py`
- Test: `tests/test_camera.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] With angle 0 and the eye at the origin, to_screen is the identity
- [ ] The followed point always lands exactly on the eye point
- [ ] INVARIANT: while rotating, the gravity direction maps to screen-down (0, 1) at EVERY step of a flip
- [ ] In fixed mode the eye is dead centre and nothing about the framing moves with gravity
- [ ] to_world(to_screen(p)) == p

**Verify:** `PYTHONPATH= .venv/bin/pytest tests/test_camera.py -v` -> all pass

**Steps:** see the task section in the plan document for the full TDD steps and code.

tasks.subject: Task 9: browser build, playtest, verdict
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Answer slice 2's three criteria by playing it, natively and in the browser, and write the verdict down.

> **USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Create: `docs/superpowers/runbooks/<date>-slice-2-rotation-verdict.md`
- Modify: the slice 2 spec status, `README.md`, `presets/default.json`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] The full suite passes, with the count recorded in the runbook
- [ ] pygbag --build succeeds AND the built game is played in a browser for at least five minutes
- [ ] Criterion 1 (no re-orientation beat), 2 (comfortable at rate), 3 (a bad crossing is your fault) each get an explicit yes/no with reasoning
- [ ] Final flip_duration and chamber_depth are recorded as winning values in presets/default.json
- [ ] The fixed-camera mode is confirmed to exist and be usable
- [ ] Coverage gaps are recorded plainly, in the style of the slice 1 feel verdict

**Verify:** The runbook exists, names the build SHA, and states PROCEED or STOP

**Steps:** see the task section in the plan document for the full TDD steps and code.
